answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 14381 Country: India Title: Asslamwalaikum brother suppose if i dont change bedsheet after having sex with my wife and next day bed sheet goes dry automatically and i sleep on the same bed sheet and am fully paak but bed sheet was not paak, so am i paak for namaaz or i have make ghusal? Question: Asslamwalaikum brother suppose if i dont change bedsheet after having sex with my wife and next day bed sheet goes dry automatically and i sleep on the same bed sheet and am fully paak but bed sheet was not paak, so am i paak for namaaz or i have make ghusal? Answer ID: 14381 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1100/1100=M/1430) If any impurity stuck to a bed sheet and it got dry, you will not be required to have bath just by sleeping on the impure sheet, you will be considered clean. But, it is necessary to wash the place of impurity. An impure sheet should be used after washing and making it clean. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
